ownership.quote: ScitiX is an unfunded Singapore-based technology startup founded in 2025 that provides a platform for training, tuning, and serving AI models.

stage.quote: ScitiX is an unfunded company based in Singapore (Singapore), founded in 2025.
stage.note: Tracxn (aggregator) lists the company as unfunded/self-funded as of Aug 2026. A separate Google AI-overview summary claimed a seed round 'led by Lobby Capital', but a repeat query on the same engine explicitly retracted that link ('there are currently no public records of a funding round or a direct connection between ScitiX and Lobby Capital... likely confusion with' unrelated deals like StackAI/apate.ai also led by Lobby Capital), so that claim is rejected as an AI-search hallucination, not used here. Legal entity ScitiX (SGP) Tech Pte. Ltd. was incorporated April 2024 in Singapore; a related entity ScitiX Space (SGP) Pte. Ltd. was incorporated January 2023.

note: ScitiX is a Singapore-incorporated (April 2024) AI cloud / GPU infrastructure company (scitix.ai) offering GPU clusters, inference, fine-tuning and, as an open-source side project on GitHub (scitix/Agent-Sandbox, Apache-2.0), an E2B-compatible agent sandbox runtime built on Kubernetes Pods (container isolation, not microVM). No confirmed funding, investors, or revenue figures were found; Tracxn lists it as unfunded. A Google AI-overview surfaced an unverifiable/contradicted claim of a 'seed round led by Lobby Capital' which a repeat search on the same engine explicitly walked back as likely confusion with unrelated Lobby Capital deals (StackAI, apate.ai) — excluded from the stage/funding numbers above out of caution.
